events.title: Room now, or protocol only?
events.decision: Ship a live Silver Board room as org infrastructure, or keep the Board as prose until Mission Control Sprint 6.
events.brief: Thierry asked 7MAN to create an interactive Silver Board, using Roast Room as UX template, and to plan 7Ei OS integration. Charter Art. 1 forbids a debate panel. Precedence 01 forbids a required cloud runner.

options.label: Ship the private repo and OS pointer now
Park the room until Mission Control Sprint 6

suntzu.reason: Energy economy of a second surface

bezos.reason: Two-way door vs waiting for a platform

rule.reason: Stuff (a used protocol) vs paper (a slide)

events.text:
SEAT: Buffett
STANCE: Conditional
OPTION SCORES: A 7/10 · B 6/10 · C 4/10
CONFIDENCE: 4/5
RUIN RISK: none
PRECEDENCE FLAG: none

THE CALL: Build the small room now if it stays cheap and private; do not fund a platform.
THROUGH MY LENS:
- Circle of competence: 7Ei already runs agents; a local viewer is inside it (S002).
- Ruin first: a public likeness-board would be a reputation hole (S005).
- Fat pitch: waiting for Mission Control Sprint 6 is optional, not required (S007).
THE TENSION I HOLD: Attention spent on furniture vs attention spent on sittings that change a gate.
WHAT WOULD CHANGE MY MIND: A cost that starts eating engineering weeks every sprint.
QUESTION FOR THE CHAIR: What is the cash and calendar cost of v0 versus v1 portraits?

parsed.call: Build the small room now if it stays cheap and private; do not fund a platform.
parsed.oneLine: Attention spent on furniture vs attention spent on sittings that change a gate.

events.name: Warren Buffett

events.text:
SEAT: Sun Tzu
STANCE: Yes
OPTION SCORES: A 8/10 · B 5/10 · C 3/10
CONFIDENCE: 4/5
RUIN RISK: none
PRECEDENCE FLAG: none

THE CALL: Take the terrain (a used table) before arguing the campaign (MC Sprint 6).
THROUGH MY LENS:
- Win without fighting: a file protocol already is the army; the room is the flag (S001).
- Terrain: humans will not consult a vault note under pressure (S002).
- Prolonged operations: parking until Sprint 6 is a long siege with no grain (S005).
THE TENSION I HOLD: A flag with no army is theatre; an army with no flag is invisible.
WHAT WOULD CHANGE MY MIND: Proof that operators already convene the Board from the vault without being asked.
QUESTION FOR THE CHAIR: Who will actually type /silver-board in the next fourteen days?

parsed.call: Take the terrain (a used table) before arguing the campaign (MC Sprint 6).
parsed.oneLine: A flag with no army is theatre; an army with no flag is invisible.

events.name: Sun Tzu

events.text:
SEAT: Bezos
STANCE: Strong yes
OPTION SCORES: A 9/10 · B 4/10 · C 2/10
CONFIDENCE: 4/5
RUIN RISK: none
PRECEDENCE FLAG: none

THE CALL: This is a two-way door. Ship the local room; reverse it if nobody sits.
THROUGH MY LENS:
- Two-way door: a private Node viewer is reversible (S002).
- Work backwards: the customer of the Board is Thierry under a hard call, not a slide (S001).
- Day 1: waiting for MC is process as proxy (S004).
THE TENSION I HOLD: One-way would be public portraits and a hosted model. That is not what was asked.
WHAT WOULD CHANGE MY MIND: A P01 requirement to send briefs to a third-party API.
QUESTION FOR THE CHAIR: Are we inventing a product or installing a working backwards loop?

parsed.call: This is a two-way door. Ship the local room; reverse it if nobody sits.
parsed.oneLine: One-way would be public portraits and a hosted model. That is not what was asked.

events.name: Jeff Bezos

events.text:
SEAT: Taleb
STANCE: Conditional
OPTION SCORES: A 6/10 · B 5/10 · C 7/10
CONFIDENCE: 5/5
RUIN RISK: possible
PRECEDENCE FLAG: none

THE CALL: Protocol with skin. A room without sittings is a fragile toy; prose without use is also a toy.
THROUGH MY LENS:
- Skin in the game: if 7MAN does not convene it on the next gate, it is consultant theatre (S001).
- Via negativa: do not add portraits, APIs, or PDFs (S005).
- Narrative fallacy: "interactive board" can hide that nobody changed a decision (S004).
THE TENSION I HOLD: Option C is honest if the org will not sit. Option A is honest if the first sitting is a real 777 score.
WHAT WOULD CHANGE MY MIND: A scheduled gate that will use this in fourteen days.
QUESTION FOR THE CHAIR: Who is harmed if the room is pretty and the Signal is ignored?

parsed.call: Protocol with skin. A room without sittings is a fragile toy; prose without use is also a toy.
parsed.oneLine: Option C is honest if the org will not sit. Option A is honest if the first sitting is a real 777 score.

events.name: Nassim Nicholas Taleb

events.text:
SEAT: Watts
STANCE: Conditional
OPTION SCORES: A 6/10 · B 5/10 · C 6/10
CONFIDENCE: 3/5
RUIN RISK: none
PRECEDENCE FLAG: none

THE CALL: Do not confuse the table with the seeing.
THROUGH MY LENS:
- Menu is not the meal (S001).
- Clutching a board aesthetic is insecurity dressed as governance (S002).
- Play: a small local room can be play; a platform cannot (S005).
THE TENSION I HOLD: Humans sometimes need a table to remember they have a mind.
WHAT WOULD CHANGE MY MIND: If v0 starts needing a brand film.
QUESTION FOR THE CHAIR: Can we sit without watching ourselves sit?

parsed.call: Do not confuse the table with the seeing.
parsed.oneLine: Humans sometimes need a table to remember they have a mind.

events.name: Alan Watts

events.text:
SEAT: Rule
STANCE: Yes
OPTION SCORES: A 8/10 · B 4/10 · C 3/10
CONFIDENCE: 4/5
RUIN RISK: none
PRECEDENCE FLAG: none

THE CALL: Prefer stuff: a repo you can run, not a note that claims a board exists.
THROUGH MY LENS:
- Stuff vs paper (S001).
- A slide deck is not a mine (S006).
- Patience: fill the other forty brains later (S003).
THE TENSION I HOLD: Grade of v0 is a local viewer plus seven seats. Do not promote it as a finished field.
WHAT WOULD CHANGE MY MIND: If running it required someone else's cloud.
QUESTION FOR THE CHAIR: What is the working capital — tokens per sitting?

parsed.call: Prefer stuff: a repo you can run, not a note that claims a board exists.
parsed.oneLine: Grade of v0 is a local viewer plus seven seats. Do not promote it as a finished field.
